text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In late November, I have the Japan Cup
with Tokai Teio coming up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "This summer, I desire physical conditioning that will not lose to hers."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I await your orders, Master.
I shall carry out any training you assign.

—Our final summer training camp
with Mihono Bourbon had begun.
